title: Layout (print-true card layout spec)
description: OPTIONAL per-game declarative card layout: templates/layout.yaml. Positions every visual element of a physical card in millimeters so ONE renderer (layoutCard() in tools/hub_template.html) can turn card + printing data into the actual print-ready card -- in the cards grid, the card modal, the live card editor preview (re-rendered on every keystroke), the PR visual diff, and the true-physical-size print sheet. A game with no templates/layout.yaml keeps using the generic data-driven cardFrame() -- this file is additive, never required.

card.description: Physical card dimensions, in millimeters. layoutCard() renders the TRIM box (w_mm x h_mm); printSheet() also reads this (falling back to 63.5x88.9 poker/trading-card size when a game has no layout.yaml) so the print grid matches the card's real size.

bleed_mm.description: Bleed allowance beyond trim. Documentation/export-planning only -- layoutCard() renders the trim box, it does not currently paint a separate bleed margin.

bg.description: Card background: a hex color, or the literal string "palette" to resolve via the top-level palette (e.g. a faction-tinted card back).

back.description: Shared, project-level card-back treatment used by Studio, exact-version faces, duplex exports, VTT packages, and releases. Legacy text/color fields remain valid; regions opt into the same declarative renderer used for fronts.

bg.description: CSS background color for the shared back.

art.description: Optional versioned artwork path for declarative back regions to bind through g.layout.back.art.

regions.description: Optional editable back layers, painted with the canonical layout renderer. When absent, Forge preserves the legacy centered-title back.

fonts.description: Named font faces regions reference by id via their own "font" key. Loaded best-effort from Google Fonts by family name at render time; every use also carries a generic serif/sans-serif fallback stack, so an offline build still renders (with substitute fonts).

asset.description: Optional versioned local font file relative to the game directory. Preferred for reproducible production output.

local_asset.description: Optional unversioned local font override relative to the game directory. Used when present; asset remains the portable fallback. This permits a designer to use a legitimately installed commercial production font without redistributing it.

palette.description: Data-driven visual lookup. Regions can resolve palette colors and optional reusable CSS surface motifs through the selected card field, e.g. one faction-aware frame shared by every card family.

by.description: Dot path naming the card field that selects a color, e.g. "attributes.faction" (bare paths resolve against the card first).

default.description: Fallback color when the resolved value has no entry in map.

motifs.description: Resolved-value -> reusable CSS background slots. A motif may contain {palette}, which expands to the selected color. Regions consume these through palette-shell-motif or palette-panel-motif.

default_motif.description: Fallback motif slots for values absent from motifs.

text_styles.description: Reusable named typography tokens. While a region references one through text_style, these values are authoritative for its typography; geometry, content binding, and effects remain local. This makes a title/body/caption change reviewable once across every affected family.

regions.description: Every visual element on the card, painted in array order (later regions draw on top of earlier ones) -- so put frame/background rects first, art next, then text/badges on top.

condition.description: show_if condition, evaluated against the card/printing context: a bare dot path (truthy = shown, e.g. "attributes.attack"), "!path" (shown when falsy/absent), or "path == value" / "path != value" (string equality).

id.description: Unique within the layout. Used for highlight-on-diff matching and debugging.

group.description: Optional persistent group id. Regions with the same id select and move together in Forge Studio while remaining independent paint-order entries for deterministic rendering and external adapters.

text_style.description: Optional named style from top-level text_styles. Its typography values are authoritative while attached; detach materializes them back onto the region.

type.description: text: one line/short field. richtext: multi-line body text with [symbol] chips + optional autoshrink. image: printing/card artwork (paints a credited, tinted placeholder -- for a PHOTO the layout is crediting an artist for). badge: circular/square numeric chip (cost, etc). pips: repeat a glyph according to a numeric field (influence/loyalty). row: evenly-spaced inline cells (e.g. stat line). rect: undecorated frame/bar/divider -- no text, no data. background: a full-bleed (or partial) decorative image -- a reusable frame/border texture, NOT artwork needing a credit strip -- meant to be the first region in the array so every later region paints on top of it; degrades to a flat (palette-aware) color the same way image does when src is empty or 404s, but without image's artist-credit chrome. Added for importing official card templates whose frame is itself a texture asset (see docs/layout-engine.md's 'Importing an official template' case study).

w.description: mm. Required for all types except badge (which uses d).

h.description: mm. Required for all types except badge (which uses d).

d.description: Diameter in mm -- badge only, alternative to w/h.

shape.description: Badge shape, or pips-only geometric socket shape when filled_src is present.

src.description: Dot path ("card.name", "printing.art_url", "card.attributes.cost") or a "{path} literal {path}" interpolation template. text/richtext/image/badge/background.

fallback_srcs.description: image only: ordered dot paths tried when src resolves empty. Source-specific cropping is not applied to fallback artwork.

secondary_src.description: body only: optional second flowing field, normally printing.flavor_text.

secondary_font.description: body only: fonts[].id for the second field.

transform.description: Optional deterministic display transform applied after resolving src.

text.description: Literal static text, used instead of resolving src (e.g. a fixed caption).

map.description: Optional resolved-value -> display-value mapping for text, badge, image, or background regions.

glyph.description: pips only: repeated display glyph; defaults to a filled circle.

count.description: pips only: optional fixed count for static socket tracks; when absent, count resolves from src.

filled_src.description: pips only: numeric dot path giving how many slots are filled when count declares a fixed socket track.

fill_from.description: pips only: which end of a fixed socket track fills first.

pip_d_mm.description: pips only: diameter or side length of geometric sockets.

filled_bg.description: pips only: CSS or palette background for filled geometric sockets.

empty_bg.description: pips only: CSS or palette background for empty geometric sockets.

filled_stroke.description: pips only: CSS or non-gradient palette color around filled sockets.

empty_stroke.description: pips only: CSS or non-gradient palette color around empty sockets.

pip_stroke_w_mm.description: pips only: geometric socket outline width.

pip_shadow.description: pips only: CSS box-shadow applied to every geometric socket.

max.description: pips only: safety cap on repeated glyphs; defaults to 20.

credit.description: Dot path for an artist/source credit caption overlaid on an image region, e.g. "printing.artist". Also shown on the tinted placeholder used when the image fails to load or src is empty.

source_crop.description: image only: x,y,w,h crop rectangle in source pixels.

source_size.description: image only: full source width,height in pixels, used with source_crop.

source_crop_fit.description: image only: fill preserves legacy crop behavior; cover trims the declared source crop around its center so artwork keeps its original proportions inside the target region.

strong_weight.description: richtext/body only: font weight used for semantic **strong** spans. Keeps emphasis in source data while letting each design system choose its production weight.

strong_terms.description: richtext/body only: exact game terms to render as semantic strong text when the source does not already mark them with **strong**. Useful for versioned game-specific keywords without hardcoded renderer rules.

min_size_pt.description: text/richtext/body shrink-to-fit floor -- won't shrink smaller than this. Defaults to max(5, size_pt-4). Remaining overflow at this floor blocks production review and strict export.

char_width_em.description: text/richtext no-wrap initial estimate in em. Defaults to 0.7; the browser and exact exporter then measure the loaded font.

valign.description: text/badge only -- richtext is always top-aligned (reading text).

color.description: CSS color, or a palette token: palette, palette-dark, palette-deep, palette-light, palette-soft, palette-paper, or palette-metallic.

bg.description: CSS background, or a palette token: palette, palette-dark, palette-deep, palette-light, palette-soft, palette-paper, palette-metallic, palette-gradient, palette-shell-motif, or palette-panel-motif.

horizontal_scale.description: text/richtext only: horizontal glyph scaling for production faces that use condensed or expanded typography without substituting a different font.

paragraph_gap_em.description: body only -- vertical space, in em, inserted between newline-delimited rules paragraphs. The gap participates in autoshrink calculations.

no_wrap.description: text/richtext only: keep the value on one line; normally paired with autoshrink.

symbols.description: richtext only -- parse [key] tokens (game.yaml symbols) into glyph chips, same convention and look as cardFrame().

icon_only.description: richtext only: center a single [symbol] asset and scale it to the region box. Useful for faction, set, and stat iconography.

autoshrink.description: text/richtext/body -- shrink size_pt in deterministic 0.25pt steps, after fonts load, until measured content fits or min_size_pt is reached. Remaining overflow is an error.

fill.description: CSS background or palette token (including palette-shell-motif and palette-panel-motif), or "none". rect only.

stroke.description: CSS color or non-gradient palette token. rect only.

clip_path.description: Optional CSS clip-path for angular production geometry, e.g. polygon(0 0, 94% 0, 100% 50%, 94% 100%, 0 100%).

shadow.description: Optional CSS box-shadow for production depth. Applies to any positioned region.

shadow_spec.description: Portable structured shadow authored by Forge Studio. This takes precedence over the legacy raw CSS shadow field and renders consistently in preview and exact print output.

border.description: Portable border for any region. Rect regions may continue to use their native stroke fields; this object makes the same capability available to text, image, badge, and other positioned regions.

text_shadow.description: Optional CSS text-shadow for production numerals and outlined display text.

filter.description: Optional CSS filter applied to a region, e.g. invert(1) for a dark SVG on a dark footer or grayscale(1) for a watermark.

blend_mode.description: Optional CSS blend mode for a region. Multiply is useful for colored print marks supplied on a white SVG canvas.

direction.description: pips only -- arrange repeated marks horizontally or vertically.

of.description: row only -- cells distributed evenly across the row's box.

key.description: Dot path for this cell's value, e.g. "attributes.loyalty".

label.description: Static caption shown with the value.

show_if.description: Region (or row cell) is only drawn when this evaluates true -- e.g. a stat row that only appears on cards with attributes.attack.
